note: Last-known positions from a terrestrial AIS sample (typically within about 200 km of a shore station). Ships far offshore, or silent during this window, keep an older last-known fix or appear as not seen. This run sampled 5 of 5 MMSI batches (200 ships, ~75s each). A position older than 6 hours is marked stale. Not a live feed and not a complete census.
